You in?|Tor Bez'lin, to Verosha Aniseya|}} '''Tor Bez'lin''' was a [[Shorwilt]] security expert who was arrested in the [[Corporate Sector]] during the [[High Republic Era]] and [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]''. Bez'lin and the imprisoned [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]] tried to recruit the rumored [[Jedi]]-killer [[Verosha Aniseya]] into an escape plan, but when she refused they deactivated the [[prison ship]]'s [[Variable geometry droid|droid pilots]] anyway and caused the ''Palwick'' to exit [[hyperspace]] in the [[Carlac belt]]. Bez'lin then used his head [[Limb|tentacle]] to decapitate a [[Unidentified droid warden|warden droid]] and open he and Dunn's cell, escaping along with most the other prisoners in an [[escape pod]]. When they were recaptured and placed in a cell in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], Bez'lin and Dunn tried to blame the escape on Aniseya. ==Biography== ===Secured security expert=== {{Dialogue|Aniseya|Is it hurting him?|Dunn|No way! He's having a great time.|Bez'lin|It does weird stuff to your brain.|attr=Verosha Aniseya, Syreth Dunn, and Tor Bez'lin discuss the dybbuk silencing Melo Tolicus|src=}} Tor Bez'lin was a criminal [[Shorwilt]] security expert who was arrested in the [[Corporate Sector]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Due for [[Detention Task Force]] processing, he was placed in a cell on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' alongside the [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]] and several members of [[Dunn's crew]] in [[132 BBY]].{{TheAcolyteDate}} Part way through its journey to the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], the ''Palwick'' docked with the [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]'' to collect [[Verosha Aniseya]], a new [[prisoner]] who was accused of [[Indara's murder|murdering]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. Aniseya was placed in a cell adjacent to Bez'lin and Dunn, who were impressed with her rumored crime, as they had never heard of anyone [[Death|killing]] a [[Jedi]] before. When Aniseya noticed that the prisoner [[Melo Tolicus]], who was in the other cell neighbouring hers, was being silenced by a [[dybbuk]] over his [[mouth]], Dunn provided her with the [[Parasite|parasitic]] creature's name. Aniseya then queried if the dybbuk was hurting Tolicus, but Dunn reassured her that the prisoner was having a great [[time]] and Bez'lin explained that the parasite effected its host [[brain]] in strange ways. When Dunn asked her, Aniseya denied killing Indara, but Bez'lin invited her to take part in an [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escape]] they were planning any way. ===Short-lived escape=== {{Quote|It wasn't our idea.''"
"''It was the Jedi-killer! She orchestrated the whole thing.|Bez'lin and Dunn|}} When Dunn explained that his compatriot [[Rott Mercer]] would deactivate the [[prison ship]]'s [[variable geometry droid]] [[pilot]]s so that the prisoners could flee in [[escape pod]]s, Aniseya refused to join as the plan might kill them. Dunn then pointed out that her alternative was to leave her fate in the hands of the [[Jedi Order]], but she retorted that she trusted the Jedi, causing Bez'lin to scoff and tell her to enjoy [[prison]]. Dunn then commenced the plan, causing the ''Palwick'' to exit [[hyperspace]] and crash into the [[Carlac belt]]. When the ship's [[Unidentified droid warden|warden droid]] declared a security breach and approached the cells, the Shorwilt propelled his coiled head [[Limb|tentacle]] at the [[droid]] and pulled it against the cell bars before tearing its head off. Bez'lin then used the tentacle to rip of the droid's arm and manipulate it to open the cell door. First out the door, he then escaped the ''Palwick'' in an escape pod with all the other prisoners besides Aniseya and Tolicus. Their new freedom did not last long and all of the prisoners bar Aniseya were quickly recaptured and brought to Coruscant. Bez'lin, Dunn, and his crew were placed together in a holding cell behind a [[force field]] on the detainment level of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]. When Jedi Master [[Sol]] walked past the cell, Bez'lin slammed his fist against the wall and claimed the escape had not been their fault, with Dunn blaming Aniseya for orchestrating it all. Sol then interogated Tolicus in a separate cell and he revealed the truth. ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Dunn|So you'd rather leave your fate to the Jedi?|Aniseya|Yes, I have faith in the Jedi.|Bez'lin|Enjoy prison.|attr=Syreth Dunn, Verosha Aniseya, and Tor Bez'lin discuss the escape plan|src=}} Tor Bez'lin was a [[Color|gray]]-skinned, amphibious Shorwilt. He was impressed by the possibility of Verosha Aniseya having killed a Jedi, but scoffed at the idea that she had faith in the Jedi Order and later tried to falsely blame her for the escape when in Jedi custody. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|Come on.|Tor Bez'lin prepares to attack the warden droid with his head tentacle|}} Tor Bez'lin was a skilled security expert who was versed in both programming and electronic lock-breaking. He could also propel his strong and fibrous head tentacle with great speed and impact as part of a brute force methodology. ==Equipment== While imprisoned, Bez'lin wore a gray [[Clothing|shirt]] with a black short-sleeve jacket, a brown [[belt]], and black pants. ==Behind the scenes== Tor Bez'lin was voiced by [[Robin Atkin Downes]]{{Twitter|Robin_A_Downes|status/1799892845370695923|[[Robin Atkin Downes]]|date=2024-06-09|quote=One of my characters is in the trailer! Check out #TheAcolyte #StarWars #GreatGigs|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ugp7B}} and physically portrayed by performance artist [[Liam Cook]] in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Creatures effects artist [[Robert Skene]] worked on the mould for Bez'lin as part of [[Neal Scanlan]]'s team.{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=p/C9sKJa6oOFo|name=[[Robert Skene]]|date=2024-07-21|quote=Now that Acolyte has finished, here are just a few of the characters I was involved with bringing to life. Everything was a huge team effort with everyone at CFX, and it was a dream come true, getting to be a part of it. My contribution varied from character to character, including clay walling, matrix molds, drafting cores, processing 3d printed molds, molding prosthetics and more, working alongside the fantastic team in Moldshop under Kenny Wilson. #starwars #theacolyte #cfx #creaturecantina #moldmaking #mouldmaking|archivefile=File:RobertSkene-TorBezlin-Instagram.png}} Both of Bez'lin's scenes were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} The episode's credits only identified that character as "Convict – Tentacle" and Bez'lin was first named in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''. ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|6tzur6JrUEA|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker - First Details}} *{{InsiderCite|227|Creature Comforts (article)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Tor Bez'lin}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Tor Bez'lin |fr=Tor Bez'lin |ka=ტორ ბეზ'ლინი |tr=Tanımlanamayan dokunaçlı hükümlü }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bez'lin, Tor}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Dunn's crew]]
